abilities.name: Daemonic Speed
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Spite-tongue Curse
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
abilities.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Aelfskin Scroll
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit. After that **^^Spell^^** ability has been resolved, that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use a **^^Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **^^Spell^^** abilities that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use this phase.

abilities.name: Rune of Murder
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's melee weapons to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Darkflame Pendant
abilities.effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.

abilities.name: The Conquerer's Crown
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target does not have the 'Obscuring' terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model's unit.

abilities.name: Infernal Puppet
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^Spell^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^Spell^^** ability.

abilities.name: The Varanite Shackle
abilities.effect: Friendly non-**^^Warriors of Chaos Slaves to Darkness^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Amulet of Chaos
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **^^Darkoath Infantry^^** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Head of the Unworthy
abilities.effect: If a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Hero^^** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

abilities.name: Rally the Tribes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If there is a friendly **^^Darkoath Hero^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Unique Darkoath^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: United in Darkness
abilities.effect: While there is at least 1 friendly **^^Warriors of Chaos Hero^^** and 1 other friendly **^^Daemon Hero^^** or **^^Darkoath Hero^^** on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

abilities.name: You Will Serve!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Daemon Prince** to use this ability. Then, pick a visible friendly non-**^^Daemon^^** non-**^^Unique Slaves to Darkness^^** unit that does not have an Ensorcelled Banner wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove any **Pledge to Chaos** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **Pledge to Chaos** keywords this unit has.

abilities.name: Ironclad Onslaught
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
abilities.effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the 'Eye of the Gods' ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

abilities.name: Deathmonger
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal (3)** the target instead if it is a Monster.

abilities.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **^^Darkfire Daemonrift^^** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them

abilities.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Eroding Icon
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: The Banner of Rage
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Khorne^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: The Banner of Screaming Flesh
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Blasted Standard
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

abilities.name: The Dread Banner
abilities.effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Brand of Unbreakable Bonds
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Brand of the Unaligned
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.
abilities.effect:
Remove all of this unit's **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
• **^^Pledged to Khorne^^**
• **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^**
• **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^**
• **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^**
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Brand of Apoplexy
abilities.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons.
